name: Weekly review
description: Review active commitments, recent outputs, and next-week focus across the second-brain workspace.

nodes.label: Collect inputs
nodes.description: Gather open tasks, recent artifacts, and inbox or queue items relevant to the review.

artifact.description: Input summary for the weekly review.

nodes.label: Triage queue
nodes.description: Choose which inputs should be promoted, kept, deferred, archived, or discarded.

nodes.label: Choose focus
nodes.description: Pick the next useful focus and name what will intentionally not be pursued.

artifact.description: Weekly focus, tradeoffs, and next actions.

nodes.label: Finalize review
nodes.description: Finalize the review artifact with a valid PARA tag and update tasks.

artifact.description: Reference to finalized weekly review and task updates.
